value.name: DescriptorOffsetAppend
value.doc: Append descriptor table entry after previous table.

value.name: RootSignatureDwords
value.doc: Defines the amount of usable space in root signature.

value.name: TransientMaxBarrierCount
value.doc: Defines the amount of barriers of all types that will not trigger allocation.

value.name: MaxPlaneCount
value.doc: Defines the amount of planes that can be present on the single (YUV) image.

value.name: MinSupportedInputAttributes
value.doc: Defines the minimum amount of vertex attributes that must be supported by the implementation.

value.name: MinSupportedInputBindings
value.doc: Defines the minimum amount of vertex bindings that must be supported by the implementation.

value.name: MaxRenderTargets
value.doc: Defines the maximum amount of render targets that can be bound at once.

value.name: MaxViewports
value.doc: Defines the maximum amount of viewports that can be bound at once. The same count applies to scissors.

value.name: MaxCopyRegions
value.doc: Defines the maximum amount of present rectangles and copy regions in the Copy* commands that can be used in a single operation.

value.name: WholeSize
value.doc: Select whole size of a resource.
